subject: ddl: skip adding index reorg work for empty tables (#56406)
summary: Adds an empty-table fast path for ADD INDEX to avoid starting reorg/backfill when the target table has no rows (including partitioned tables), and skips temp-index merge work when the temp-index keyspace is empty. Implements lightweight existence checks via a 1-row table scan and a snapshot key-iteration probe over temp-index ranges; keeps state-machine transitions intact (WriteReorg -> Public / BackfillState progression) and conservatively disables skipping once reorg has started (job.SnapshotVer != 0). Also rolls back the meta txn on admin DDL-job commit failure and updates tests/expected infoschema outputs.
